# Vendored globe data

- `d3.min.js`: D3 7.9.0, ISC license; includes `d3-geo`.
- `topojson-client.min.js`: TopoJSON Client 3.1.0, ISC license.
- `countries-50m.json`: World Atlas 2.0.2 country topology, ISC license; based on Natural Earth public-domain data.

These files are loaded locally; the globe does not request map tiles or external APIs.
